reason: This is the only available action, and the picture shows liver cells joining glucose into a store.
expectation: I expect some glucose to be stored as a branched carbohydrate inside the liver cells.

effect: The result shows that liver cells store linked glucose and can break the store down when other tissues need fuel. The chapter is complete.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the glucose become a store, though the only choice made the outcome predictable.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the liver carbohydrate store was worthwhile because it connected glucose from a meal to fuel available between meals.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter was very short, and its only action was already shown by the picture, so there was little to figure out.

surprise.text: The result added that the liver can break the store down again when other tissues need fuel; the starting picture mainly showed it being built.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary: glucose entering liver cells matched both the goal and the picture.

continue.text: I might continue to see what happens to the stored fuel, but I would hope for more meaningful choices than this chapter offered.
